title: ToolProgress
description: A tool is still running: how long it has been at it, from the engine. The text of the row is the client's, from the `label` of the `tool.started` with the same `toolUseId`.

chunk.description: The elapsed time, as `<seconds>s` — never the tool's name, which the client already has as the `label` of the `tool.started` (plan 28, S-48).

parentToolUseId.description: Set when this comes from a subagent: the `toolUseId` of the `agent` call that opened it. Absent on the main conversation.
